name: Možemo
detail: 2024 programme: tax of 0.7% on a third and further residential properties (property only); also a windfall tax. Not a net wealth tax.

name: SSSH (Mario Švigir)
detail: Wealth tax on non-essential property proposed in 2009.

name: Mate Kapović / David Bilić
detail: 2020-21 Radnička fronta proposal to tax savings above about 700,000 kuna; reported second-hand and a savings levy, not clearly net wealth.

name: Vladimir Čavrak
detail: Said he would support a real wealth tax but only commented that the 2024 property tax is not one; page returns 403 to scripts.
